title: Drainage and vent air test.
officialText: An air test shall be made by forcing air into the system until there is a uniform gauge pressure of 5 psi (34.5 kPa). This pressure shall be held for a test period of at least 15 minutes. Any adjustments to the test pressure required because of changes in ambient temperature or the seating of gaskets shall be made prior to the beginning of the test period.
